en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 290 - Narrated Ja’far bin Muhammad bin Malik Kufi from Ishaq bin Muhammad bin Abu Hashim from Furat bin Ahnaf that he said:
Amirul Momineen (a.s) mentioned the Qaim (a.s) and said: “He will go into hiding, so the ignorant will say that Allah does not have any need of Aale Muhammad (a.s).”
